summary: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of common stock and pre-funded warrants to existing and new healthcare investors. The company will issue 2,098,519 shares at $56.00 per share and 133,625 pre-funded warrants at $55.9999 each, raising gross proceeds of approximately $125.0 million. The offering is expected to close on August 7, 2026. Net proceeds will fund clinical development and general corporate purposes. The company imposed a 90-day lock-up on further equity issuance and directors and officers also entered lock-up agreements. The placement is a strategic capital raise, not a routine financing.
